title: PPG-MS26 — PRD + GA Gate + Beta Program + Feature Flag Service
description: Closes the product-readiness gap surfaced by R20 scrutiny (score 51). Defines PRD-level North-Star metric, GA gate criteria, beta program structure (3-5 lighthouse customers, NDA template, feedback loop, beta→GA graduation), feature flag service for per-shop/per-machine/per-tier rollout, deprecation matrix, customer-facing roadmap.
rationale: Closes the product-readiness gap surfaced by R20 scrutiny (score 51). Defines PRD-level North-Star metric, GA gate criteria, beta program structure (3-5 lighthouse customers, NDA template, feedback loop, beta→GA graduation), feature flag service for per-shop/per-machine/per-tier rollout, deprecation matrix, customer-facing roadmap.

units.title: PRD + North-Star metric + GA gate criteria
units.scope: North-Star: ≥25% cycle-time reduction across 50-prog corpus AND ≥3 paying lighthouse customers signed-off. GA gate checklist; PM-owned launch readiness.

units.title: Beta program structure + NDA template
units.scope: 3-5 lighthouse customers; NDA + DPA + LOI templates; beta feedback loop (weekly call + telemetry review); beta→GA graduation criteria; CAB charter.

units.title: Feature flag service (per-shop / per-machine / per-tier)
units.scope: LaunchDarkly-style flags for L3 FOCAS/OPC-UA writes (MS1), MS17 cross-simulator, MS11 closed-loop. Dark-launch + canary + kill switches. Shop-by-shop + machine-by-machine rollout.

units.title: Product analytics + funnel instrumentation
units.scope: Wizard step events, feature-adoption telemetry, abandonment tracking, time-on-step. PM weekly dashboard separate from MS11 machine telemetry.

units.title: Deprecation matrix for 6 superseded MS + consumer-engine notification
units.scope: PP-REV-MS5/6, PPG-VAR-MS0, PPG-REAL-MS0, F360-REV-MS8, F360-FULL-MS5: list consumers, migration deadlines, notify-by dates. Pre-commit hook warns on consumer-engine modifications.

units.title: Customer-facing roadmap page + changelog
units.scope: Public 'what's coming next' page; weekly changelog; CAB feedback channel; roadmap visibility increases trust + enables design-partner LOI conversations.

completion_criteria: PRD published with North-Star metric + GA gate criteria
Beta program enrolls ≥3 lighthouse customers with signed NDA + DPA + LOI
Feature flag service controls L3/MS17/MS11 per shop+machine+tier
Product analytics dashboard surfaces wizard funnel + feature adoption weekly
Deprecation matrix tracks 6 superseded MS with migration timelines
Customer-facing roadmap page live; changelog updated weekly
